description: Create a new lab request in HospitalRun for existing patient Kwame Mensah (Patient ID: P00001). Navigate to the 'Labs' section (flask icon) and create a new request. Search for and select 'Kwame Mensah'. Set the Lab Type to 'Complete Blood Count'. In the notes/description field, enter: 'Patient presents with fatigue, dizziness, and conjunctival pallor. Rule out iron-deficiency anemia. Fasting not required.' Save the request. Ensure the request status is 'Requested'.
